title: a detection window below the floor blocks save and names the minimum
verifies: a window narrower than schedule + histogram is rejected with the exact floor minimum named

title: a valid window shows the minimum and recommended hint
verifies: a valid window renders the floor hint with minimum and recommended values

title: the floor and hint recompute live from schedule and histogram
verifies: the floor hint recomputes when the governing intervals change

title: seconds and days interval units feed the floor
verifies: the s/d interval units are selectable and seconds feed the floor computation

title: a new config defaults the detection window to 3 hours
verifies: the shipped default detection window is 3h, not 1h

title: the hint is suppressed while the window is in error
verifies: error and hint never render together; error takes precedence

title: a window exactly at the floor is accepted
verifies: the boundary window (schedule + histogram) saves without a floor error

title: an untouched below-floor saved config warns and saves verbatim
verifies: a grandfathered below-floor row warns instead of erroring and round-trips unchanged

title: editing any governing field clears the legacy warning and re-applies the floor
verifies: the first edit to a governing field clears the legacy warning and live validation takes over
